samples.summary: rest-api.md §5 (the canonical enumeration of the /api/v1 surface) is not updated for the ~15 endpoints this change adds
samples.evidence: §5.2 still lists only `GET/POST /tabs` and `PATCH /tabs/:tid` ("Reads and mutates tab metadata…", lines 195-211), while the diff adds `DELETE /tabs/:tabId`, `POST /tabs/:tabId/reorder`, `POST /tabs/:tabId/duplicate`, `GET|PUT /tabs/:tabId/images`, `GET /documents/:did/layouts`, `POST|DELETE /documents/:did/slides…`, and the whole `/documents/:did/comments` tree. §5.5 still says the content routes serve `doc`/`slides`/`note` only, but board is now dispatched there too (docs-content.controller.ts). CONTRIBUTING/design discipline expects the canonical subsystem doc to be updated rather than left describing a smaller surface; notifications.md and sheets/comments.md were updated, so the omission is inconsistent within the change itself. Behaviour is unaffected — cost is doc drift only.
searchedFor: Glob docs/design/**/*.md for a separate v1-endpoint doc

samples.summary: cli.md's exhaustive command tree (§4) and safety-annotation table (§8.4) are not updated for the new `board`, `comments`, `sheets images`, `slides slide/layouts` and `sheets tabs delete/move/duplicate` commands
samples.evidence: §4 lists `sheets tabs` as exactly `list | create | rename` (line 430-433) and enumerates every other sheets/slides subgroup; §8.4's per-command safety table (lines 1582-1640) likewise enumerates each schema entry. The change registers ~15 new commands and 16 new schema entries (packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts) with no corresponding doc rows, so the design doc now understates what the CLI does. Non-blocking: the commands work and `wafflebase schema` is the runtime source of truth.

samples.summary: The capability audit's class-B table — the stated justification for this whole change — is left asserting these gaps are still open, unlike the class-A/A′ tables which carry "since shipped" notes
samples.evidence: Lines 211-217 still read "Comments | 6 | No comment controller under /api/v1", "Slide granular editing | 5 | No add / duplicate / delete / move-slide or list-layouts endpoint", "Tab rearrange | 3 | … there is no DELETE", "Sheet floating images | 2 | no per-worksheet image endpoint", "Board | 2 | docs-content.controller.ts:94 rejects any type that is not doc / slides / note" — every one of which this diff closes. The doc establishes its own precedent for this at lines 142-148 and 171 ("the class-A table above now has commands … the table is left as measured" plus a note). No equivalent note was added for class B, and comments.controller.ts's own docblock cites this table as still-current evidence.

samples.summary: The canonical mentions design doc still names `packages/frontend/src/components/comments/mentions.ts` as the home of the grammar after the implementation moved to `@wafflebase/sheets`
samples.evidence: comments-mentions.md line 87 heads the section "New shared helper — `packages/frontend/src/components/comments/mentions.ts`" and lines 98-127 declare `parseMentionBody` / `serializeMention` / `extractMentionedUserIds` as living there. The diff moves all of them to packages/sheets/src/comment/mentions.ts, leaving the frontend file a re-export shell. notifications.md records the move, but the repo files docs by subsystem and expects the canonical doc to be folded rather than the fact recorded in a neighbouring one. The backticked path still resolves, so the top-level path check will not catch it.

samples.summary: `PATCH :threadId/comments/:commentId` (edit a comment) has no HttpClient method, CLI verb or schema entry, so a capability this change adds is unreachable from the agent surface it exists to serve
samples.evidence: comments.controller.ts adds `editComment`, but packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts's comment block (listComments … deleteComment) has no `editComment`, packages/cli/src/commands/comments.ts registers list/add/reply/resolve/unresolve/delete/delete-comment only, and packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts adds no `comments.edit`. Every other verb in this change was carried end-to-end (endpoint → client → command → schema), so the edit route is a dangling backend-only surface. Cost is a capability an agent cannot reach, not a broken one.
searchedFor: read the comments schema entries in the diff (registry.ts)

samples.summary: The Yorkie array in-place reorder semantics are now stated twice — backend `applySlideChange` and frontend `yorkie-slides-store.ts#moveSlide` — with no shared module
samples.evidence: slide-ops.ts's `move` branch reimplements the `moveFront` / `moveAfterByIndex(to, from)` vs `moveAfterByIndex(to - 1, from)` index arithmetic that packages/frontend/src/app/slides/yorkie-slides-store.ts already implements (its docblock says so: "`yorkie-slides-store.ts#moveSlide` makes the same choice for the same reason"). The rest of the change is careful about single-sourcing (MemSlidesStore for the slide model, @wafflebase/sheets for thread and notification rules), so this is the one place two copies of an ordering rule can drift into different deck orders. Mitigating: the frontend package is not importable from the backend, so extraction would mean a new home in slides/core — hence minor rather than major.

samples.summary: Thread creation is unsupported for word-processor documents, so the "Comments" class-B gap is closed for sheet/pdf only
samples.evidence: createThread throws BadRequestException for `type === 'doc'` because a `docs-range` anchor is a pair of Yorkie tree positions. The reasoning is sound and documented in-line and in the CLI help, but neither docs/design/docs/docs-comments.md nor the audit records the resulting partial coverage, so an agent workflow that expects to open a comment on a doc has no documented statement of the limitation outside a runtime 400 message. Flagged for visibility; I could not check it against an acceptance list because no issue text accompanied the diff.
